_comment: Copy to $YOKE_HOME/config/sources.json and edit. Toggle sources, add target companies (their ATS + slug), tune the search dorks. jobspy (LinkedIn/Indeed) is OFF by default — those sites' terms restrict scraping; enable at your own discretion.
